description: Chintu aur Mithu ke saath robot ban kar naacho! Yeh dance bacchon ko rhythm aur physical coordination sikhata hai.
learning: Coordinating body movements and following simple rhythm patterns.

scenes.text:
चिट-चैट, रोबोट की चाल,
हाथ हिलाओ, मचाओ धमाल।
scenes.image_prompt: A cute round orange baby elephant with a blue scarf and a tiny green parrot with a red cap standing in a shiny colorful playroom, waving robotic stiff arms.

scenes.text:
Move your arms, straight and stiff,
Like a robot, give it a lift.
scenes.image_prompt: A close up of the orange elephant lifting his arms stiffly like a robot in a garden.

scenes.text:

scenes.text:

scenes.text:

scenes.image_prompt: A close up of the elephant's big sparkly eyes blinking one by one.

scenes.text:
सिर हिलाओ, गर्दन घुमाओ,
रोबोट की तरह तुम मुस्कुराओ।

scenes.text:

scenes.text:

scenes.text:
रुको-रुको, अब हिलना नहीं,

scenes.text:
ताल बजाओ, सुर में गाओ,

scenes.text:

Robot dance, so much fun,
